name: Forgotten Pool
summary: Past the Moonshrine Ruins, Forgotten Pool lies beneath the flooded halls of Blackfathom Deeps. Its dark waters hide monstrous deep-sea predators.

sections.title: A Submerged Lair
sections.body: You reach Forgotten Pool by diving through the sunken waterways beyond the Moonshrine Ruins. Dark water fills this isolated cavern, cut off from dry ground. Twilight's Hammer cultists chant nearby, and naga patrol the flooded halls, but the pool lies apart from them. Old Serra'kis, an ancient aquatic terror, lairs in its depths, hidden by the water.

faq.q: Where is the Forgotten Pool located?
faq.answer: Forgotten Pool lies deep within Blackfathom Deeps, beyond the Moonshrine Ruins. You reach the submerged cavern by swimming through flooded tunnels.

faq.q: What lurks inside the Forgotten Pool?
faq.answer: Old Serra'kis, an ancient thresher-like beast of the deep waters, lurks in Forgotten Pool. The secluded cavern is its lair.

faq.q: Does the Forgotten Pool lead anywhere else?
aliases: is forgotten pool a dead end
faq.answer: No. Forgotten Pool is an underwater dead end with no further passageways. It is a secluded aquatic nest.

angles.text: As a Horde scout in Blackfathom Deeps, you may find Old Serra'kis lurking in Forgotten Pool, far from the cult's chanting halls.
